blocks.title: claude-p
blocks.tagline: Emulate claude -p inside an in-process zmux PTY with zero ~/.claude mutation.
blocks.text: A Zig 0.15.2 CLI and embeddable library driving interactive Claude Code over a nonce-tagged hook FIFO, with one-shot text/json output and a dual-watchdog NDJSON daemon.

announcement.label: v0.1.3: Claude Code 2.1 compatibility and coverage-guided fuzzing

blocks.title: One-shot automation
blocks.code:
git diff main | claude-p --output-format json "Review this diff for regressions"

# Live transcript streaming plus final claude -p result envelope
claude-p --output-format stream-json --verbose "Explain src/driver.zig"

blocks.title: Multi-turn NDJSON daemon

cards.title: Zero ~/.claude mutation
cards.text: Every relay hook script and FIFO lives in an ephemeral $TMPDIR directory and cleans up on exit.

cards.title: Stateful DEC and XTerm responder
cards.text: Handles DA1, DA2, DSR, XTVERSION, and 18t queries even when split across PTY reads so Ink never hangs.

cards.title: macOS TTYHOG safe paste
cards.text: Chunked UTF-8-safe bracketed paste under 512 bytes with ESC[201~ neutralization and acceptance watchdog.

cards.title: Long-lived NDJSON daemon
cards.text: Incremental paste keeps ping and interrupt responsive while idle and transcript watchdogs catch stalls.

cards.title: SHA-256 install trust root
cards.text: Bundled checksums.json and required SHA256SUMS verify every prebuilt binary before extraction.

cards.title: Property and fuzz verified
cards.text: Coverage-guided Zig fuzzing and 4,000+ supply-chain trials run continuously on Linux and macOS.

cards.title: Lighthouse Audit Report
cards.text: Live Uphill gauges across footprint, TigerStyle, correctness, testing, documentation, and trust boundaries.
